orientation_notes.Q2: Ry(90 deg) (insertion axis = world x, horizontal)

excluded_orientation.note: Reachability-limited exploratory orientation (Rx35 Ry45 oblique). The Panda could not realize the oblique pre-insertion configuration over the screened common workspace (0/96 nominal feasibility, all FAIL at align_keyed). This is an embodiment/workspace limitation, not a failure of the learned transformation law; it provides no counter-evidence to P_Q(s) invariance because it never entered the learning stage.

task_anchor_note: COMMON workspace anchor shared by Q1 and Q2, chosen by coarse nominal feasibility (Q1 62/96, Q2 64/96, common 40/96; margin-maximizing interior cell). Chosen from IK/collision feasibility only, never from Pdiag results.

gripper.note: Firm gripper to hold the peg through the axial contact during horizontal insertion (default ~23 N squeeze slipped ~5 cm).

solver.pedestal: kinematic stand at [-0.25, -0.18, 0.28] holding the peg elevated

screening_result.note: 3 Q1 first-attempt failures were all at seed 20280818 circular_insert (du-, dv-, dpsi-) and recovered within 2-3 retries; no systematic failure.

success_criteria.orientation_vs_seed_variability: D_orient should be comparable to (or below) D_seed

metrics.D_P: RMSE of canonical generator profiles between orientations
metrics.D_orient: RMSE between orientation-mean profiles (Q2 vs Q1)
metrics.D_seed: mean over orientations of within-orientation seed-pair profile RMSE
